settings.title: Full-Grain Italian Calfskin
settings.text: Sourced from small family-run tanneries in Tuscany. Supple to the touch with a delicate pebble grain that develops a rich patina.

settings.title: Unstructured Ergonomic Slouch
settings.text: Drapes naturally under the arm without rigid cardboard stiffeners. Soft yet structured enough to stand on its base when set down.

settings.title: Custom Solid Brass Hardware
settings.text: Every buckle and magnetic closure is machined from solid brass and brushed to a warm satin finish that will never peel or rust.

settings.title: Reinforced Saddle Stitching
settings.text: Critical stress points are hand-tacked with high-tensile waxed thread, ensuring the shoulder strap remains secure through years of daily commute.

settings.question: Will my phone fit inside the bag?
settings.answer: Yes. The bag easily accommodates all modern smartphones up to the iPhone 15 Pro Max and Samsung Galaxy Ultra series, even when enclosed in a protective case, alongside a bifold wallet and keys.

settings.question: Is the leather water resistant?
settings.answer: Our full-grain leather is naturally resilient to light humidity and brief rainfall. If caught in rain, simply blot gently with a dry cotton cloth and allow it to air-dry at room temperature away from heat sources.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched from our studio warehouse within 24 hours on business days. Standard delivery within the US takes 2–4 business days. Complimentary tracking is emailed upon fulfillment.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day trial period. If the bag does not suit your everyday needs, return it in original, unworn condition with its dust bag for a full refund. A prepaid return shipping label is provided.

settings.question: Can the shoulder strap length be adjusted?
settings.answer: The strap has a fixed 28 cm drop proportioned specifically to tuck securely under the arm and stay positioned on the shoulder without sliding off your coat.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subhead: Straightforward answers regarding sizing, leather care, and shipping.

settings.heading: Fewer, Better Things.
settings.story_text:
We founded our studio on a single conviction: modern wardrobes do not need dozens of seasonal bags that quickly date and discard. They need one archetype, resolved so thoroughly in its proportion, feel, and durability that you reach for it without hesitation every morning.

We bypassed traditional wholesale markups and retail licensing to invest directly where it matters—in full-grain hides, hand-painted edge dyes, and solid brass components meant to outlast trends.
